functions.docs:
Returns a uint8 array view representation of the Code FSharedBuffer, for compatibility's sake (much downstream
usage of shader code expects an array of uint8)

functions.name: GetCodeBuffer
functions.docs: Return the buffer storing just the shader code for this resource

functions.name: GetSymbolsBuffer
functions.docs: Return the buffer storing the (compressed) symbols for this resource

functions.name: GetCacheBuffer
functions.docs: Returns a single composite buffer referencing both the header and code data to be cached.

functions.name: Unpack
functions.docs:
Unpacks the given FSharedBuffer into separate header/code buffer views and returns them as a 2-segment composite buffer.
Note that this is required since when pushing a composite buffer to DDC it does not maintain the segment structure.

functions.name: PopulateFromComposite
functions.docs:
Sets the Header and Code shared buffer references in this resource to the segments referenced
by the given composite buffer.

functions.name: PopulateHeader
functions.signature: PopulateHeader(Uncompressed Size, Shader Code Size, Frequency)
functions.docs:
Populates the header for this code resource with the given sizes and frequency.
Note that this is done as a separate process from the construction of the Code buffer
as the shader frequency is only known by the owning job, and not stored in the FShaderCode.

functions.name: GetUncompressedSize
functions.docs: Retrieves the uncompressed size of the shader code as stored in the FHeader buffer.

functions.name: FShaderCode

functions.docs: ShaderCode may be compressed in SCWs on demand. If this value isn't null, the shader code is compressed.
